about: What a real LEGO EV3 (stock firmware unless a row says otherwise) does, one entry per benchmark row, with where the number comes from. kind: measured (someone measured it on hardware), spec (LEGO's published figure), derived (computed from a primary source: firmware code or a measurement, the derivation in `how`), estimate (first-principles physics from measured constants, not measured itself: a suspicion to check), none (no real measurement found: measure this on a robot first). lo/hi is the real band; tol widens it by an absolute amount (tol_abs) or a fraction of the band's middle (tol_rel) before the verdict. Read by scripts/twin-bench.ts; the table in docs/twin-fidelity.md is its output.

philo.what: Philo's motor comparison: no-load speed and current at a 9 V lab supply (EV3 large 175 rpm, 60 mA; medium 260 rpm, 80 mA), stall torque and current at 9 V (large 43 N.cm, 1.8 A; medium 15 N.cm, 0.78 A), loaded speed vs supply voltage (large at 17.3 N.cm: 78 rpm at 7.5 V, 105 rpm at 9 V; medium at 6.64 N.cm: 120 rpm at 7.5 V, 165 rpm at 9 V).

lego_ug.what: LEGO MINDSTORMS Education EV3 User Guide (LEGO, 2013): large motor 160-170 rpm, medium 240-250 rpm; ultrasonic 3-250 cm with +-1 cm, 255 = nothing detected; infrared proximity 0-100 detects objects up to 70 cm; gyro up to 440 deg/s, +-3 deg on a 90 deg turn; colour sensor sample rate 1 kHz.

lms2012.what: The stock firmware's motor driver. Speed scale (comment above dCalculateSpeed, COUNTS_PER_PULSE_LM 12800 / _MM 8100 on a 33 MHz/256 timer): speed 100 = 128 timer ticks per encoder count for a large motor = 1007 deg/s, 81 ticks for a medium motor = 1591 deg/s. Brake (BrakeMotor, state BRAKED): power = -TachoCnt * 400, saturating at full reverse 25 counts past the stop point.

thingsdaq.what: Things DAQ: four EV3 large motors driven by duty cycle (unregulated) at 40-100 %, bare shaft: median first-order time constant 76 ms; 86 and 98 ms with 0.00023 and 0.00045 kg m2 added; effective shaft inertia 0.0014 kg m2.

ev3dev.what: ev3dev sensor appendix: US-DIST-CM 0-2550 with 1 decimal (0.1 cm); IR-PROX 0-100, '100% is approximately 70cm'; GYRO-RATE -440..440, clockwise positive; COL-REFLECT/COL-AMBIENT 0-100; RGB-RAW 0-1020.

issue518.what: EV3-G (stock firmware) infrared proximity with a white wall at 38 cm: always 40 or 41; with black on the wall: 88-90.

jj.what: An EV3 ultrasonic localization project: the sensor needs to be within +-25 deg of square to the wall; maximum 255 cm but readings above 200 cm unreliable.

ev3basic_gyro.what: About 40 hand rotations of one EV3 gyro on a turntable: fast 360 deg clockwise read 351-355 (mean 353), counter-clockwise 359-363 (mean 361); slow rotations read worse (326-353 clockwise); rate is rounded to whole deg/s; once it began wandering at -0.5 deg/s after a slow turn; a robot turning back and forth 10 x 360 deg ended 80-360 deg off, worse at low speed.

hwlog.what: This repository's runs on a real EV3 (robot R: large motors B and C, 5.6 cm wheels, IR on S4, no gyro) on ev3dev, not stock firmware: ev3dev's own speed regulator and a 600 ms (2026-11-21) or 21-149 ms (2026-11-22) link. Battery 8.06 and 8.27 V.

first_principles.what: Physics from the measured constants above; each row says how. Not a measurement: what to measure first.

large_speed_25.how: 25 % of the firmware's speed scale, 1007 deg/s per 100 %

large_speed_100.how: 100 % asks for 1007 deg/s, more than a battery gives: no-load speed at 7.5-8.3 V scaled from Philo's 175 rpm at 9 V with his loaded slope (18 rpm/V): 148-162 rpm = 888-974 deg/s, before H-bridge loss and robot load; top of band LEGO's 170 rpm

medium_speed_100.how: no-load at 7.5-8.3 V from Philo's 260 rpm at 9 V with his loaded slope (30 rpm/V): 215-239 rpm = 1290-1434 deg/s; top of band LEGO's 250 rpm

large_report_50.how: what the shaft does at 50 %; the row's twin value is what speed_deg_s reports on the twin

medium_report_50.how: what a medium shaft does at 50 %; the twin value is what speed_deg_s reports (one deg/s-per-% factor for every motor)

power_t63.how: open-loop time constant, bare shaft 76 ms, loaded 86-98 ms

power_50_speed.how: unregulated 50 % duty: half the battery-limited no-load speed (888-974 deg/s at 7.5-8.3 V); less under load

speed_t63.how: the regulated loop (lms2012 dRegulateSpeed PID) on a step was never measured; the twin applies the open-loop 76 ms to it

hw_run_degrees_90_20.how: ev3.B run_degrees 90 @20: 47 deg inside the 250 ms bound (ev3dev, 2026-11-21)

hw_drive5_overshoot.how: drive 5 cm @25: encoders 115/122 deg against 102 (ev3dev, WiFi 21-149 ms)

hw_square_side.how: drive 15 cm @30 four times: encoder sides 15.7-16.1 (ev3dev, WiFi 21-149 ms)

hw_square_turn.how: turn 90 four times, heading by encoders: 91.5-99.6 (ev3dev, WiFi 21-149 ms)

brake_overshoot_25.how: full reverse from v0 with the 76 ms constant: tau*v0 - tau*vmax*ln(1+v0/vmax), vmax 1007; the firmware's brake ramps up over 25 counts, so more; then it returns to the stop point

coast_ms_100.how: float: friction alone. Coulomb torque = no-load current x torque constant = 0.06 A x (0.43 N m / 1.8 A) = 0.014 N m; t = J w / T with J 0.0009-0.0014 kg m2 (Things DAQ; tau x k^2/R from Philo's stall figures) and w = 17.6 rad/s

coast_deg_100.how: constant deceleration over that time: w t / 2

coast_deg_50.how: a quarter of the 100 % figure (distance grows with the square of speed)

blocked_tacho.how: a wheel against a wall: 0.4 N m of stall torque against a tyre's grip of about mu N r = 0.8 x 3 N x 0.028 m = 0.07 N m on a 0.7 kg base; the wheel slips and its encoder keeps counting, the regulator holds the speed, no stall. Held by hand, the shaft stops. Measure: drive into a wall

us_250.how: the edge of the range (jj: unreliable here)

us_noise.how: LEGO's +-1 cm accuracy bounds the spread of a still reading; no measured spread found (jj modelled 10-15 cm for robustness, not as a measurement)

us_min_2.how: LEGO's range starts at 3 cm; what it reads closer is unpublished (ev3dev's range starts at 0)

us_angle_15.how: within +-25 deg it works; along the axis the slanted wall is 51.8 cm away

us_angle_30.how: beyond +-25 deg it does not operate

us_post.how: LEGO only says an object can be too small to detect; no measured width/range

us_post_blind.text: seen wherever it sits inside the cone
us_post_blind.how: a real sensor's beam is continuous: an object inside it returns some echo; whether a 5 cm post at 2 m is above its threshold is unmeasured

us_inner_corner.how: two walls at 90 deg send a ray back along itself (a corner reflector) whatever the angle: a room corner seen at 45 deg echoes strongly

us_box_corner.how: a convex corner at 45 deg: specular faces send the sound away, the edge diffracts a little; unmeasured

ir_70.how: sources disagree: linear from the 38 cm point gives 75; LEGO 'detects up to 70 cm' and ev3dev '100% is approximately 70cm' give 100

ir_100_at.how: first distance that reads 100: 70 cm (LEGO, ev3dev) or 94 (linear from issue518's point)

ir_noise_38.how: EV3-G read 'always 40 or 41': a standard deviation of about 0.5

gyro_turn90.how: |gyro - true| on a 90 deg turn, LEGO's +-3 deg; the twin value is the 95th percentile over 30 seeds

gyro_cw360.how: one sensor, fast clockwise 360 by hand (reading as a clockwise magnitude); the twin value is the mean over 30 seeds

gyro_slow360.how: the same sensor, slow (10 s) clockwise 360; the twin turns at 5 %

gyro_rest_60s.how: 'a steady reading in port view when the robot was still' after a still power-up; the same unit once wandered -0.5 deg/s (30 deg/min)

gyro_rate_max.how: the sensor measures up to 440 deg/s; the twin value is what rate_deg_s reads spinning at 100 %

gyro_reset_moving.how: what a reset while turning does on the real sensor is unmeasured

color_edge_width.how: the reflected profile across a line edge versus height is unpublished; robolab recommends 8-12 mm

color_id_edge.how: what colour mode reports while the spot straddles a black-white edge: unmeasured (often reported as blue or green; not a measurement)

color_rgb_white.how: RGB-RAW on white paper: unmeasured; ev3dev lists 0-1020

color_ambient.how: depends on the room's light; the twin has none

color_white_black.how: reflected % of the workshop's floor and tape: measure

touch_travel.how: plunger travel before it reads pressed: unpublished

rate_us.how: how often the ultrasonic value changes in continuous mode: unpublished

battery_v.how: robot R's battery on the two days it ran; a fresh 6 x AA reads near 9 V, a low one near 6.5

battery_sag.how: voltage with two motors at full speed: unmeasured

rtt_usb.how: a direct command's round trip over USB HID through the bridge page: unmeasured (docs/hardware-log.md: not run)

tone_call_ms.how: SOUND TONE starts the tone and the direct command returns at once (c_sound.c); the call does not wait for the tone

tacho_target.how: a host-stopped degree target on stock firmware: the stop lands one round trip plus the brake's overshoot late; unmeasured

none_drive.how: a 50 cm drive on stock firmware over USB, measured with a ruler: not run

none_turn.how: a turn measured with a protractor (wheels with gyro; tracks by encoders): not run; for tracks the twin's turn_scrub 0.2 comes from a 4-wheel P3-AT (Wang et al., ICR 1.47, https://www.mdpi.com/1424-8220/15/5/9681), not an EV3

none_drift.how: straight-line drift over 2 m: not measured on any EV3

read_changes_path.how: reading a sensor does not move a robot

time_ratio.how: a real robot's second is a second
